channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from PNallDR, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: 9/11 Heroes: Army Nurse Patricia Horoho's Courage
item.description: On 9/11, an Army nurse rushed to the Pentagon crash site without supplies, setting up a triage point that treated 75 people.

item.title: NASA's Orbital Data Centers Could Ease Grid Strain
item.description: NASA chief Jared Isaacman suggests solar-powered AI data centers in orbit could resolve U.S. disputes over land, water, and power.

item.title: Maine Democrat Backs Trump's Tariff Stance
item.description: Rep. Jared Golden, whose district borders Canada, supports President Trump's escalating tariff policies.

item.title: Trump Administration to Increase Haiti Deportations
item.description: The administration plans to boost deportation flights to Haiti, potentially accelerating removal of thousands.
